summary_zh: 合并 8625 次成功 update 与 1 次失败 forward 后，云南外 32 个 tau 最大值可精确恢复；云南内最大值、区域像元 p99/p99.9 和精确超阈值计数不可恢复。
limitations: Saved records contain whole-grid extrema/means/std/medians and one outside pixel; no full spatial qlog arrays or regional histograms.
The 8625 successful observations cover updates 41913..50537, not every successful update of the original training run.
Null is unavailable, never zero. Bounds are not measured counts or regional percentile estimates.
Per-forward maximum percentiles describe maxima across forwards, not percentiles across pixels/taus.
Known outside extreme does not establish absence of extreme values inside Yunnan.

definitions.requested_percentile_views: Both pooled pixel-quantile values and per-forward regional maxima; recoverable parts only.
definitions.percentile_method: Linear empirical quantile, h=(n-1)*p; p99=p=.99, p99.9=p=.999.
definitions.grid_source: Saved executed observer.py.txt and masks.py.txt; no mask/raw reopen.
definitions.pooled_pixel_quantile_distribution: All scene-pixel-tau exposures in the region over the selected forwards.
definitions.per_forward_region_max_distribution: One maximum over all regional pixels/taus/batch elements per saved forward.
definitions.outside: Complement of frozen Yunnan evaluation mask within the 100x100 target grid.
definitions.count_units: Per-tau scene-pixel exposures; their sum is scene-pixel-tau exposures. Any-tau counts a spatial pixel once per scene/forward. Repeated scenes are not deduplicated across forwards.
definitions.count_bounds_method: Global min > log1p(rate) proves all regional pixels exceed; per-tau whole max <= log1p(rate) proves zero; otherwise count upper bound is batch*regional_cells. The saved outside witness supplies a lower bound without double counting.
definitions.threshold_purpose: Descriptive diagnostics only; not exclusion criteria, training rules, QC or scientific thresholds.
definitions.whole_grid_supplement: Unpartitioned distributions of saved per-forward maxima. No regional pixel percentile is inferred from them.

witness.membership_source: Saved Observer.capture Yunnan_mask; mask was not reopened.
